decision_clause: Ruled out: filtering the roadmap and Board out of a broad input scan, because an exclusion list would silently admit future projections; inputs must instead be positively declared and closed.
label: COMPLIANT

rationale: Within the active recorded scope, the implementation uses positive declarations: a fixed catalog path, catalog-declared ticket paths, fixed output surfaces, and explicitly invoked operational commands. The repository-wide walk in the planning validator is a conformance and source census; it does not exclude the Board or roadmap from an operational-readiness input set, and the Board is explicitly read and validated there. No projection exclusion list implementing the ruled-out approach is present. The supplied diff is also empty, so it introduces no contrary implementation.
